verdict.rationale: MailerLite is an email-sending platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces and spam complaints is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic suppression, bounce or complaint handling, or unsubscribes being honored across campaigns, automations and API sends. The nearest items, dynamic segments and subscriber-change webhooks, are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
